Zameen o aasmaan ka har zarra Khuda ki tasbeeh kar raha hai ke usi ke liye mulk hai aur usi ke liye hamd hai, aur wahi har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Usi ne tum sab ko paida kiya hai, phir tum mein se kuch momin hain aur kuch kaafir, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekh raha hai
Usi ne aasmaan o zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai aur tumhaari soorat ko bhi intehaai husn banaaya hai, aur phir usi ki taraf sab ki baazgasht bhi hai
Woh zameen o aasmaan ki har shai se baakhabar hai, aur un tamaam cheezon ko jaanta hai jin ka tum izhaar karte ho ya jinhein tum chhupaate ho, aur woh seenon ke raazon se bhi baakhabar hai
Kya tumhaare paas pehle kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ki khabar nahin aayi hai ke unhon ne apne kaam ke wabaal ka maza chakh liya aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

Yeh is liye ke un ke paas rasool khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aate the to unhon ne saaf keh diya ke kya bashar hamaari hidaayat karega, aur yeh keh kar inkaar kar diya aur munh pher liya, to Khuda bhi un se be-niyaaz hai, aur woh qaabil-e-taareef Ghani hai

In kuffaar ka khayaal yeh hai ke inhein dobaara nahin uthaaya jaaega. To keh dijiye ke mere Parwardigar ki qasam! Tumhein dobaara zinda kiya jaaega aur phir bataaya jaaega ke tum ne kya kya kiya hai, aur yeh kaam Khuda ke liye bahut aasaan hai
Lihaaza Khuda aur Rasool aur us noor par imaan le aao jise hum ne naazil kiya hai, ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Woh qiyaamat ke din tum sab ko jama karega aur wahi haar-jeet ka din hoga. Aur jo Allah par imaan rakhega aur nek aamaal karega Khuda us ki buraaiyon ko door kar dega aur use un baaghaat mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, woh unhi mein hamesha hamesha rahenge, aur yahi sab se badi kaamyaabi hai
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur hamaari aayaat ko jhutlaaya woh ashaab-e-Jahannam hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain, aur yeh un ka badtareen anjaam hai
Koi museebat naazil nahin hoti hai magar Khuda ki ijaazat se, aur jo saahib-e-imaan hota hai Khuda us ke dil ki hidaayat kar deta hai, aur Khuda har shai ka khoob jaanne waala hai
Aur tum log Khuda ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo. Phir agar inhiraaf karoge to Rasool ki zimmedaari waazeh taur par paighaam pahuncha dene ke ilaawa kuch nahin hai
Allah hi woh hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur tamaam saahibaan-e-imaan ko usi par bharosa karna chaahiye

Imaan waalo! Tumhaari biwiyon aur tumhaari aulaad mein se ba'z tumhaare dushman hain, lihaaza un se hoshyaar raho. Aur agar inhein maaf kar do aur un se darguzar karo aur inhein bakhsh do to Allah bhi bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Tumhaare amwaal aur tumhaari aulaad tumhaare liye sirf imtehaan ka zariya hain, aur ajr-e-azeem sirf Allah ke paas hai

Lihaaza jahaan tak mumkin ho Allah se daro aur us ki baat suno aur itaa'at karo aur raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karo ke is mein tumhaare liye khair hai, aur jo apne hi nafs ke bukhl se mahfooz ho jaaye wahi log falaah aur najaat paane waale hain
Agar tum Allah ko qarz-e-hasana doge to woh use doguna bana dega aur tumhein maaf bhi kar dega, ke woh bada qadr-daan aur bardaasht karne waala hai
Woh haazir o ghaaib ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai
